title: MAFAR-LDS Launches 2026 Farm Field School Enrollment
body: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Agrarian Reform – Lanao del Sur is now accepting enrollees for the Rice-Based Farm Field School program across 8 municipalities. Interested farmers may register through their local Municipal Agriculture Office.

title: SWARB Livelihood Kits Distribution Schedule Released
body: Beneficiaries of the Support to Women ARBs (SWARB) program can now check the distribution schedule for their livelihood starter kits. Distribution will be done province-wide over the coming weeks.

title: Draft: Coffee Quality Competition Guidelines
body: Internal draft of the mechanics for the Philippine Coffee Quality Competition 2026. Not yet for public release.

title: MAFAR-LDS Weekly Radio Segment: Rice Farming Tips
body: Catch our weekly radio segment on rice-based farming techniques, aired province-wide as part of the PalayCheck School on Air program. This episode covers proper seedling spacing and water management.

title: Watch: 2026 Farm Field School Highlights
body: A short video recap of this year's Farm Field School sessions across Lanao del Sur, featuring interviews with enrolled farmers and program facilitators.

title: MAFAR-LDS Field Office Marks Farmers and Fisherfolk Month
body: The MAFAR-LDS provincial office joined region-wide activities for Farmers and Fisherfolk Month, recognizing the contributions of local farmers and fisherfolk to food security in Lanao del Sur.

title: PRDP-Funded Farm-to-Market Road Nears Completion in Lanao del Sur
body: A farm-to-market road subproject funded through the Philippine Rural Development Project (PRDP) is nearing completion, expected to cut transport time and post-harvest losses for farmers in the covered municipalities.
